sources.entry: Scratch - Lightweight, offline-first markdown notes app with WYSIWYG editing and local AI agent support. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/erictli/scratch) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Scratch
summary.one_liner: Scratch is an offline-first, open source markdown notes app with WYSIWYG editing that stores notes as plain .md files on your device.
use_cases: editing .md files in a rich text view
writing with a local AI assistant
drawing diagrams and math in notes
previewing markdown files without saving them
summary.what_it_does: Scratch stores notes on your device as plain .md files and edits them in a WYSIWYG view that saves standard markdown. It works offline with no account or cloud required. Editing can use your own Claude Code, Codex, or Ollama subscriptions for AI assistance. It supports 20 languages in code blocks, Mermaid diagrams, and KaTeX math, plus a keyboard-first interface with a command palette, focus mode, and a preview mode for opening any .md file without saving it to your folder. Customization covers theme, typography, page width, and RTL support, and optional git integration provides version control and multi-device sync.
notable: Plain .md files stored locally with WYSIWYG editing
Works with your own Claude Code, Codex, or Ollama subscriptions for AI editing
Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, and code in 20 languages
Optional git-based version control and sync
caveats: AI editing requires your own Claude Code, Codex, or Ollama subscriptions
Git sync is optional and based on git
